title: Resumable translation and parallel work can conflict in a documented mode
symptom: The documented --resume mode is mutually exclusive with --parallel-workers in Bilingual Book Maker.
user_impact: A user choosing interruption resilience may give up multi-worker speed in that route.

steps: Run resumable work sequentially using --resume; use parallel workers for separate non-resume throughput tests.

remaining_question: Is the tradeoff material on low-end local inference where workers often do not increase throughput?
verification_plan: Benchmark one licensed book sequential/resume and multi-worker with same model; record failures, elapsed time and checkpoint recovery.
